content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom billing and network software for operators; no ad measurement or verification business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Online car marketplace selling dealer listings; different business from ad verification software."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Billing and customer care software for telecom and pay-TV operators; unrelated to advertising measurement."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Sells ad campaigns, app monetization and preloads; does not measure or verify ad quality."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer service and knowledge software; different product and customers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Research subscriptions and advisory for technology executives; not ad verification software."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Owns consumer media brands and sells ad placements; a publisher, not a measurement provider."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Advertising agency network earning fees and commissions; does not sell verification software."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer experience platform for social and care; different product and buyers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Marketing and PR agency services; service model differs from verification software."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Native ad placement and content recommendation; sells ad inventory rather than verifying it."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Sports and lifestyle publisher selling sponsored content; a media owner, not a verifier."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Digital media brands plus cybersecurity and speed testing software; mixed business unlike the target."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"B2B contact data and sales intelligence for sales teams; different product and customers."}]}
